Changing the caller fixture object after issuance does not change that evidence; target-mismatch tests therefore submit changed evidence before issuance, and source-change tests mutate the actual resolver during revalidation.

limits: All source/model facts and both actors are synthetic. Real institution login, fresh official proofs, paid AI and human UI/signatures remain untested in this unit.

These wall-clock samples demonstrate ordinary and forced current/commit boundaries, not universal timing availability. A second conflict, expiry or changed authority deliberately stops; other non-controller transaction gates retain their existing behavior.
No historical run or consumed approval is resumed. Actual new run still requires separate authorization and fresh inputs.
